verdict.rationale: Bevy's docs explicitly list 2D rendering as a distinct, first-class feature alongside the 3D renderer (bevy-docs-2 vs bevy-docs-3), showing 2D isn't just a 3D afterthought, and community feedback (bevy-comm-20) references Bevy web/mobile use consistent with 2D-friendly workflows. However, there is no direct evidence of sprite-specific APIs, tilemap support, or any built-in 2D physics — these are core parts of the story left unaddressed. Missing for 10: sprite system documentation, tilemap support evidence, 2D physics integration (first-party or endorsed), and independent hands-on confirmation of a mature 2D workflow.
